text: The Midtown Zoning Review is one of three core initiatives to implement the Yonge-Eglinton Secondary Plan (Official Plan Amendment 405, also known as "OPA 405"), collectively known as "Ready, Set, Midtown". The other initiatives are the Midtown Infrastructure Implementation Strategy (MIIS) and the Midtown Parks and Public Realm Strategy. The Midtown Zoning Review is intended to implement the policies of OPA 405 via permissions in zoning. The purpose of this report is to bring forward recommended zoning by-law amendments to implement policies of OPA 405 for lands designated Neighbourhoods "A", a portion of low-rise Apartment Neighbourhoods and a portion of Parks and Open Space Areas - Parks.
